project: Boys & Girls Club Community Center - Brigham City UT

fabricationListing.result: Eight gym outlets and eleven project material-summary outlets are identified as 3 x 1-1/4 GOL; no manufacturer or outlet catalog number is stated.

nativeFab.result: Preserves outlet identities and stations but supplies no manufacturer body solid or groove manufacturing profile.

couplingInventory.result: Project inventory selects 27 Victaulic 3-inch 009N couplings L03009NPE0 and 5 Victaulic 3-inch Style 75 couplings L030075PE0; gym joint-by-joint style mapping remains absent.

seismicBom.result: Binds 13520712 to TOLCO 980-3/8 and Y379010020 to TOLCO 1001-2 X 1; nine equivalent-description rows remain unresolved.
